definitions.explanation: In soccer, a midfielder who plays on the left or right side of the midfield line, providing width in both attack and defense.

examples.japanese: サイドハーフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Be used as a side midfielder.

examples.japanese: サイドハーフ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧サイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧。
examples.english: The side midfielder charges up the right flank.

examples.japanese: サイドハーフ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: A side midfielder provides width when attacking and drops back to help when defending.

notes:
From English 'side half'. A midfielder stationed on the wing, contributing to both attack and defense down the flank.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧サイドハーフ: right midfielder
- ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧サイドハーフ: left midfielder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サイドバック→サイドバック：30059_saidobakku⟧: fullback — the defender behind the side midfielder
- ⟦ボランチ→ボランチ：30060_boranchi⟧: defensive midfielder — plays centrally rather than wide
